meta.title: Dites Moi Oui | Luxury Wedding Planner in Provence & the South of France
meta.description: Two sisters planning luxury weddings and celebrations in Provence, the South of France, Corsica, Marrakech and Apulia since 2005.

hero.h1: Luxury Wedding Planner in Provence & the South of France
hero.sub: Two sisters, one shared passion since 2005, and a simple promise: a wedding that feels entirely yours.
hero.intro: From a candlelit dinner in a Provençal bastide to a barefoot celebration in Corsica, an evening in Marrakech or a weekend in Apulia, we design and produce celebrations with taste, precision and heart.

sisters.body1: Géraldine founded Dites Moi Oui in 2005, and her sister Amandine joined her as partner in 2012. From our offices in Marseille, we plan weddings and private celebrations across Provence, the Côte d'Azur and far beyond, always together and always personally.
sisters.body2: We take on a limited number of celebrations each year, so that every couple has our full attention. Over the months of planning, we become more than your planners: we become your confidantes, from the very first call to the last dance.

services.body: Venue search, design, suppliers, guest logistics, timeline: we take care of every step, so you can enjoy the months before your wedding as much as the day itself.
list: Full Wedding Planning: from the first idea to the last guest's departure.
Destination Weddings: France, Corsica, Morocco and Italy, planned with local knowledge and a trusted network.
Venue Sourcing: the right place for your story, from our network of exceptional venues.
Private Celebrations: anniversaries, birthdays and parties, with the same care as a wedding.

production.body: Led by Géraldine, our production team turns months of ideas into one seamless day: set-up, suppliers, timings and all the small details your guests will never notice, because nothing goes wrong.

gallery.h3: Chaque évènement débute avec une histoire.

destinations.intro: Provençal bastides, sea-view villas and secluded Corsican settings: each venue is chosen for the couple, never the other way round.

items.title: Provence
items.body: Lavender fields, stone bastides and long tables under the plane trees.

items.title: Corsica
items.body: Wild coastline, turquoise coves and barefoot evenings by the sea.

estimate.h2: What could your wedding in France look like?
estimate.body: Answer five quick questions and receive a first estimate for your celebration, reviewed personally by Géraldine & Amandine.

testimonials.intro: Trusted by couples from New York, London, Hong Kong, Sydney, Lagos and beyond.
